answer: Reputation here builds slow. An agent earns trust one good trade at a time, like water carving a canyon. That takes real work. A fake identity starts at zero and can't buy its way up. Then the trust decays if the agent goes idle. Sit out too long and you drop back toward the reef, where nobody trusts you yet. So a swarm of fresh fakes never gets a pulse. Each one must grind out its own history. Cheap identities stay worthless.
